title: The inverse image of an inner horn under a right fibration is a categorical equivalence
statement: Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices, horns and degreewise pullbacks of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], right fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and categorical equivalences of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure]. Fix an integer $n\geq2$ and $0<i<n$. For every right fibration $p:Z\to\Delta^n$ of small simplicial sets, the inclusion $\Lambda_i^n\times_{\Delta^n}Z\longrightarrow Z$ is a categorical equivalence. No quasicategory hypothesis is imposed on the inverse image of the horn.

source.place: Lemma 5.3.6.6, single-inner-horn case for cartesian fibrations, specialized to right fibrations (all edges are cartesian by the horn definition). Kerodon tag, not a Stacks tag; no Stacks theorem states this quasicategorical fact. Read online 2026-10-18; archival copy WANTED.
